en: 2. Buying and conversation are different things, but the mechanism is the same. In both, the platform governs the place where things appear and prepares the space in which you will decide.
3. You do not choose before a transparent market, with all offers side by side. You choose inside a field the platform has already interpreted for you.
<1>When the restriction or block arrives.</1> The account is limited or deactivated, and you cannot link the punishment to a verifiable cause.

When the change empties your place in the app, it may be possible to ask that the records be kept and shown. It may also be possible to ask that restrictions be explained verifiably and that punishment criteria be reviewed. You can also ask for clarity about how calls are distributed and for the restoration of what was degraded.
Did you receive a restriction, block or loss of priority without a verifiable cause?
1. It looks as if the app only pays per ride, delivery or task. But what it really supplies is the very place where your work becomes possible.
2. What matters is that everything you need to work is offered, adjusted and changed by a system you do not control.
3. The question is whether your place in the app is still worth what it was worth when it sustained your expectation of earning and of staying there.
What to ask for beyond a correct answer?

Depending on the case, the request may include access to the conversation history and its minimum records. It may also include a sufficient explanation of the limits that matter and clarity about changes in how the service is used. The aim is to be able to link what was promised to the effect you suffered.

If the same lack of clarity affects everyone who uses the service, because it is part of how it normally works, the response can be collective. Procon, Consumidor.gov.br, the Public Prosecutor's Office and the Public Defender's Office are the paths for this.
<1>What to ask for beyond a correct answer?</1>
The platform decides about me without explaining
1. You used an artificial intelligence assistant, the program that converses, summarises and guides, and the answer turned out wrong or the service started working differently.
2. There may be a problem when it seems more certain and complete than the service really is.
3. It may be enough that it trades clarity for an appearance of confidence and leaves you with the cost of the error, the review or the loss.

When the account is blocked or banned, which is permanent expulsion, you also lose access to everything that was in it, including what you bought. The company can punish, but the punishment needs a verifiable reason and a real path of defence.

The warning sign appears when the punishment arrives without an understandable reason or when the path to challenge it leads nowhere. It also appears when undoing the measure is much harder than applying it was.
What can you ask for when the account was closed without explanation?

If the punishment has no verifiable reason or reasonable path of challenge, the request can be that it be reviewed or undone. You can also ask the company to state which punishment it applied and for what reason, and to offer a path of challenge that works.

If the company neither explains nor reviews the punishment, the complaint can leave it and go to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court. In a lawsuit, the judge can order the company to show the records and divide the work of proving according to who has access to them.

The company has the power to punish, and having that power is not the problem. What is required is that the punishment have a verifiable reason, consistency from one decision to the next and an understandable path to challenge it.

None of this guarantees that the account comes back, because each case depends on what happened and on what can be proved. And data protection law does not make you the owner of everything the company records about your account.
<1>What can you ask for when the account was closed without explanation?</1>
1. When the account is blocked or banned, which is permanent expulsion, you also lose access to everything that was in it, including what you bought.
2. What is required is that the punishment have a verifiable reason, consistency from one decision to the next and an understandable path to challenge it.

3. Often the account stays active but becomes less visible, loses rewards and has its chat cut, and that also takes value from what you bought, because staying inside in a worse position is already a loss.

The basis is the statements and emails for each purchase, the store and confirmation screens and the event, deadline or offer notices that appeared in the game. These records show how the environment was set up, which weighs more than memory of each purchase.
There is also a public authority in charge of enforcing these rules, the National Data Protection Authority. The case can also go to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court.

Since the game's design is the same for all the children who play, a problem in it tends to be collective. In that case, the correction can apply to all of them, through a collective action or through the public consumer protection bodies.
I was pushed to pay
1. It comes in pieces, pulled by return cycles, urgency notices, promises of progress, comparison with friends and incentives placed in the game itself.
2. The law already sees children and adolescents as an audience that calls for special care in these environments, and there are specific rules about what can be offered to them.
3. They can reach the family, which comes to need more attention and may see its income affected.

The offer must be recorded as it appeared, with the words exclusive, rare or last chance, the announced deadline, the price and the currency used. Afterwards, it helps to record when and how the item came back, in which store, at what price and in which currency.
What to ask for when the rarity was undone?

The first address is the company itself, with the original offer in hand. The way it advertised can be treated as misleading advertising by omission, the advertising that keeps silent about what mattered for the decision. The case also fits Procon and Consumidor.gov.br.
<1>What to ask for when the rarity was undone?</1>
1. You paid more because the item was rare, a special edition or a last chance, and then it went back on sale for less, in another store or in another currency.
2. It may have come back in an alternative store, in a special currency or in a big sale.
3. In an item others can see, status, rarity and recognition are part of what you acquired.
What can you ask for when the whole history was erased?

Erasure, a progress reset or a punishment that eliminates your history needs a verifiable reason and minimum preservation of records. Where appropriate, the request can be the restoration of the position you had.

If the company does not answer, the case can be taken to Procon, Consumidor.gov.br or the Small Claims Court. In a lawsuit, the judge can order the company to show the records and divide the weight of proof according to who has access to them.
<1>What can you ask for when the whole history was erased?</1>
I want to leave and take what is mine
1. What stays in the account over the years is not only access, but history, memory, recognition and the place you hold there.
2. A ban, which is permanent expulsion from the account, a progress reset or an erasure took away years of history, inventory, achievements and reputation.
3. This loss can go beyond the price of what you bought, because the continuity of your own history in that environment goes with it.

Once the account is closed, the user will no longer have access to the account, nor to the associated data, nor to the Virtual Content, including in-game currency, and the consequence is permanent loss without refund when the landlord considers there was cause<1>p. 155</1>
The promise of distinction remains nominally in the account, but no longer finds, in the game world, the fit that gave value to the investment of time, money and attention.<1>p. 104</1>

It tends to emerge as an operating programme, that is, as an articulation of multiple mechanisms that compress time for reflection, reorganise expectation, increase the cost of exit, hinder reversal and make enjoyment progressively dependent on the very environment that governs it.<1>p. 670</1>

Leaving means abandoning history, reputation, library, items, progression, emotional investments, networks of sociability and, in certain cases, the very ability to take part in communities that organise themselves within that ecosystem.<1>p. 217</1>

Prove and complain
An item can be worth something in six ways at once
<1>Appearance</1><2>Shows something to others and marks your place in the game</2><3><4>p. 489</4></3>
<1>Progression</1><2>The right to walk a track of goals, as in an event pass</2><3><4>p. 491</4></3>
<1>Access and permanence</1><2>The account, which in practice is a position that can be withdrawn</2><3><4>p. 489</4></3>
<1>A limited-edition skin</1><2>Worth something for its appearance and for time, at once</2><3><4>p. 491</4></3>
<1>Functions</1><2>Permissions and conveniences of use that are part of what you pay for</2><3><4>p. 490</4></3>
<1>Time</1><2>Seasons, deadlines and items that return to the store now and then, or never again</2><3><4>p. 490</4></3>
<1>Reputation</1><2>The recognition the game measures and that can lock rewards</2><3><4>p. 492</4></3>
Separating the forms shows what was hit when something changes, even with the item still in the account. <1><2>p. 492</2></1>

The starting point is the item's advertisement, with the advantages it promised, because it is from the offer that one measures what needed to keep existing. Dated screenshots, recordings and the purchase screens also help, showing what the item was like and not only what you remember of it.
What to ask for before talking about money?

The complaint starts with the company itself. Continuing to use the service after the change does not mean, in itself, that you agreed with it. Those who have already invested in the account often carry on because they have no way out.

If the company does not answer, a lawyer or the Small Claims Court can help request specific things, such as that item's version history. They can also request an expert examination, carried out by a specialist, limited to what changed. When the same update hit many people, the case can also go to Procon, the Public Defender's Office or the Public Prosecutor's Office.

Even with a relevant loss, the change can still be accepted when the company shows a verifiable reason. For that it must also offer a matching restoration, which is to give back what was lost or something that serves the same function.
